title: Settings
languageRegionDescription: Choose region, timezone, and how dates and currency appear. The app interface is English.
regionHint: Influences date examples and suggested currency display.
timezoneHint: Used for local time in chat, calls, and consultations.
currencyHint: Display only — checkout uses server-validated regional pricing.
aiLanguageHint: AI Guru and relationship reflections reply in this language. The rest of the app stays in English.
birthDataUnchanged: These preferences never alter stored birth date, time, place, or Kundli calculations.
